equations.heading: 3.2 Circular Entanglement Topology
equations.connection: The ring entangles every bipartition of the register, but it does not make every bipartition maximally entangled: no state of four qubits is maximally entangled across all three of its two-versus-two bipartitions at once (Higuchi and Sudbery, Physics Letters A 273, 213, 2000).
